name: 42187-longprefill-8b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of ONE a3 node (`--gres=gpu:4`), single node.
parallelism: PP=2, TP=2, DP=1, multiprocessing (`mp`) executor, one in-process vLLM engine, asynchronous scheduling on. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, dense bf16: 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, 131072 positions, 8.03e9 parameters, 16.06 GB of weights -- 16 layers and ~8.0 GB per stage at PP=2, sharded over the stage's two GPUs at TP=2 for ~4.0 GB each; KV is 128 KiB per token, 32 KiB per token per GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 20 streams, 120 requests, 34% warmup, 10% cooldown, 3600 s safety cap.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, 80000 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens, both fixed (min = max = mean) with no prefix buckets; `ignore_eos` is set, so every request generates its full 1024.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on an eight-billion-parameter model, handling 80,000-token briefs for 20 concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
# The flags this engine is launched with. Anything not named here -- dtype, max-model-len,
# max-num-seqs, compilation mode -- is left at the checkpoint's or the engine's own default.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# Two pipeline stages of two GPUs each, four GPUs on one node. 32 layers / 2 = 16 per stage, an
# even split, so VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION is neither set nor needed.
pipeline-parallel-size: 2
tensor-parallel-size: 2

distributed-executor-backend: mp
async-scheduling: true
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Pinned: unset, this engine picks 8192 or 16384 on an H100 depending on the usage context the
# in-process backend reports, and at an 80000-token prompt that number is the prefill chunk size.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
